lawyer:
Rafiqul Islam Sarder with Md Ekramul Islam, Advocates—For the Plaintiff-Petitioners
Ali Imam Khaled Rahim, Advocates—For the Defendant Opposite-Party No.1
parties:
Bazlur Rahman and others.....Plaintiff-Petitioners
vs
Moniruampur Pourashava represented by its Chairman and others Defendant-Opposite Parties
full_judgment: 3. The plaintiffs case in short is that the land measuring 28 (twenty eight) decimals in CS Plot No.210 of CS Khatian No.56 originally belonged to Tomizur Sardar, who gave settlement 1(one) decimal of land in CS Plot No.209 to Madan Bosk Kuchayan; that land measuring 49(forty nine) decimal under CS Plot No.208 of Khatian No.760 originally belonged to Tomiz Sardar. Madar Bosk kuchayan died without any issue and Tomiz Sardar took 2(two) decimals of land in CS Plot No.209 in his khas possession; that the three suit plots are situated in a compact block and adjacent to one another; that Tomiz Sarder died leaving only son plaintiff. Monirampur Union Parishad No.5 had no land or building of its own and the plaintiff for the welfare of the local people allowed the Union Parishad to use his land for temporary basis as its office on condition that the title of the suit land will remain in favour of the plaintiff and the plaintiff will pay all rents and other taxes for the land and in future if the office of Union Parishad is shifted otherwise, the suit land would be vested to the legal heirs of plaintiff and accordingly, plaintiff on 18-6-1960 executed and registered a "Nirupon deed" in favour of the then chairman of local Union Parishad and the Union Parishad started to run it's function by constructing one storied building on the said land and thereafter, some part of mouza within Monirampur Union and other two Unions declared as Pourashava and Monirampur Union Parishad shifted its office and started its functions on the land situated within Durgapur Mowza and thereupon, the effectiveness of the deed dated 18-6-1960 has been abandoned and the suit land was vested to the plaintiff and plaintiff got possession of the suit land on 15-1-2000; that Nazrul Islam ex-chairman of the then Union Parishad executed and registered a kabala deed in favour of the Pourashava illegally and Pourashava on 15-2-2000 demanded the suit land and dispossessed the plaintiff forcibly and on 1-6-2000 plaintiff asked the chairman of the Pourashava to vacate the suit land in favour of the plaintiff and Chairman refused to do so and claimed title of the land in question on behalf of Pourashava and hence, the suit.
